title: 6、塞壬小镇
slug: 我在惊悚游戏里封神无限
content_zh:
我在惊悚游戏里封神（无限）！
白柳对这些讨论一无所知，他的注意力很快就被别的东西吸引了，他看到了杰尔夫。
杰尔夫鬼鬼祟祟地躲在楼梯下，和什么人在交谈，交谈完了之后往回走。
杰尔夫之前偷偷摸摸大半夜出去了，现在居然又回来了，白柳刚刚在楼梯上视角不错，他看到杰尔夫身后跟着那个今天搭载他们来的司机，这两人似乎在小声商讨着什么，杰尔夫还递给了司机一堆花花绿绿的东西，又叮嘱了司机几句。
要是白柳没看错的话，杰尔夫给司机的应该是这个世界的钱币，虽然他不确定，但白柳对钱的判定直觉他自己是百分之百相信的。
【你已激发剧情人物隐藏支线剧情——杰尔夫的血腥密谋】
【请探索完整个支线剧情，积分奖励50，目前支线完成度百分之十五】
白柳微微眯起了眼睛，他的手伸入衣领口拿出那枚被打了孔洞的一块钱硬币对准那个司机，面板上弹出人物信息。
【npc：司机】
【人物简介：你的司机，载你们一行人来到塞壬镇的司机，该司机是对据称对塞壬镇十分了解的杰尔夫帮你雇佣的，有过纵火犯抢劫等犯罪历史】
果然，这也是个有身份的人物npc。
之前白柳和司机一直没有正面接触过，开车的时候这个司机一直坐在前座，白柳坐在最后一排，是无法看到这个司机的，而下车的时候司机又没有下车，所以白柳一直没有看到司机的样子，所以也一直没有识别出司机的人物信息的。
他之前还没觉得有什么，但现在白柳回过神来了，似乎杰尔夫一直有意无意地阻隔白柳和司机的接触，无论是选择坐在白柳和司机的中间，还是要下车的时候发出的惊叫阻止了白柳和司机的直接接触…
这两人有什么需要瞒着白柳的小小密谋。
但这密谋，根据白柳目前已知的信息可以猜测：杰尔夫拿钱给这个有过一定犯罪史的司机，让他帮自己做事情，这个事情目前暂定，白柳觉得应该是报复安德烈。
在入镇子的时候司机就已经说过这个镇子很多人已经很久没有经济来源了，让他们小心一点，之前白柳还以为这个是一种提醒，但现在看来更是这个司机一种得意又嚣张的告诫，和一种猎物的区域划分，他在向杰尔夫警告彰显他的能力，离开了他的合作和保护，杰尔夫很容易被这个镇子里的其他镇民伤害。
当然，他也是塞壬小镇的镇民，他也很缺钱，当然也有可能因为缺钱对杰尔夫这一车人做出什么抢劫的事情来。
这个司机看来没少做拿钱做一些违规的事情，看起来也不是很好控制，而且明显想钱想疯了，进塞壬镇的时候就在含沙射影地威胁他们了，也难怪杰尔夫大半夜不睡觉都要下来拿钱给这个司机了。
如果不及时拿钱，还不知道这司机会做出什么事情。
白柳在杰尔夫看到他之前，回到了自己的房间，并帮杰尔夫关好了被身子不知道放下了一块黑乎乎的什么东西，白柳从猫眼里看着杰尔夫放的那东西有点像是——一大块鱼肉？

很快白柳就看到了安德烈的房门前聚集了一堆的白森森阴沉沉人鱼雕塑。
沉闷咯吱的雕塑移动声又在走廊响起。
为了安全起见，白柳用白布蒙上了自己房间的猫眼，避免人鱼窥探，又用一个柜子抵住了门，希望要是有人鱼破门而入的时候能制造点声音把他弄醒。
他的体力值也要清空了，白柳做完这一切之后，他就躺在床。上，阖上双眸，一夜无梦。
————
第二天白柳醒来，衣柜的门和房间的大门都是闭合的，但是卫生间的门已经快要开了。
白柳布，正以各种扭曲怪异的姿势交叠在一起，往卫生间的门移动，有些人鱼雕像的手已经够到了卫生间的门把手了，离转开出来只有一步之遥。
这些人鱼雕像的姿势让白柳想起他当初玩123木头人，突然转身，看到他后面的人控制不住表情和姿态的样子，他那个时候还觉得有点滑稽和好笑，但现在看这些阴森冷白的雕塑为了出来在门后追赶涌动的样子，白柳却没什么笑意。
这些似人的大理石雕塑这样堆叠的时候，给人的压迫力是更强的，因为它们的眼睛高密度地在一个狭小的空间内凝视着白柳，这让白柳觉得很不舒服，或者说正常人在被这么多双死物的眼睛看着的时候都会觉得不舒服。
白柳合上了卫生间的门，他不再管这些雕塑，也没有捆绑它们了。
因为没有意义了。
这些东西挣脱得越来越快，如果找不到更多的弱点来控制这玩意儿，不断地蒙布捆绑就是一种性价比很低的做法，说不定还会锻炼这些雕塑快速脱绑的能力。
【玩家白柳完成主线任务——在屋内不被异化过夜，奖励积分20点】
【目前余额：23点，可以购买道具，玩家是否购买？】
白柳白柳买了一个15积分的强探照手电筒，还剩8积分——他微微思索了一下。
….不知道有没有那种3d全息投影的仪器。
【有，4积分一个，正在举行促销打折活动，8积分三个，请问玩家是否购买3个？】
白柳不假思索地点头：【要！】
作为一个缺钱的社畜，他这辈子最听不得的单词里面绝对有两个是【打折】和【促销】。
他买了之后倒是美滋滋地用自己买到手的3d投影机开玩了，而且这促销打折来的投影器质量还不赖，白柳录入进自己的人物像之后，投影出来之后，他连连惊奇地赞叹，一点劣质感都没有，色泽逼真人物鲜活，在光影暗处一打眼看，几乎就和真人差不多了。

白柳倒是很满意自己购买的商品。
但是观看他的观众却很不满意，围在小电视面前指手画脚，叹息连连。
“这新人该不是想用投影仪当做人眼霍霍人鱼雕塑吧？怪物书的弱点上都写了要人眼直视啊，这投影仪只能糊弄人鱼雕塑一会儿，撑不久的。”
“居然卖了打折的投影仪，这东西看起来高级，但毫无卵用啊！不然也不会是一积分一个都不会有人买的滞销货！这新人在想什么！”
“…..是的，我进来的时候这个投影仪就在打折，现在这么多年过去了，还在打折…”
“操，23点的积分，明明是新手区目前最高的积分，就全部给浪费了，一个有用的东西都没买！脑子进水了吗！”
忽然一个玩家在一个小屏幕面前惊喜大叫道：“快过来！！这边有个新手买了烈焰火把！这个东西克人鱼，他稳了！”
人群又哗啦啦地离开白柳的小电视屏幕面前，又围到那个据说买对了道具的新手面前，赞同地颔首。
“对，这才是常规的破关道具，这个新手思路不错。”
“烈焰火把可以用三次，把握得好，他应该是这批新人里唯一一个通关的。”
白柳的小电视面前又只剩下寥寥几个人。
【34人正在观看白柳的小电视，有167人离开】
【50人取消了白柳小电视的点赞，44人取消了白柳小电视的
白柳玩好自己的道具之后，他出了房门，先去了杰尔夫的房间内把他喊起床。
杰尔夫明显昨晚睡得很不好，肤色苍白，圆框眼镜下的眼睛下面挂着疲惫劳累的黑眼圈。
而杰尔夫房间内的人鱼雕塑数量，白柳目测了一下，和自己房间内是差不多的，但和白柳那边被他弄得关起来的雕塑不同，这些雕塑都安静地摆放在原地，也不知道是不是白柳的错觉，他觉得杰尔夫房间里的雕塑看起来明显比他的房间里那些，要逼真了一点，而且面目也变得和杰尔夫有点微妙的相似……
人鱼雕塑白皙的大理石表壳下泛着一层不透光的红润，眼珠子好像随时都能在眼眶里动起来一般，神情也是惬意又自然的，好似吸足了水分的鱼，鱼尾上的鳞片都舒展开了，而房间里也开始隐隐有一种鱼腥气。
白柳又去了露西和安德烈房间观察，他仔细地做了对比，发现这些房间的人鱼雕塑，的确要比他的房间内的…更接近人的肤色了，无论是触感还是色泽，并且都和住在房间里的人五官发生开始变得相似。
content_en:
I am a god in a thriller game (infinite)!
Bai Liu knew nothing about these discussions, and his attention was quickly attracted by something else. He saw Zeref.
Zeref was sneaking under the stairs, talking to someone, and after finishing the conversation, he walked back.
Zeref had gone out secretly in the middle of the night, and now he was back. Bai Liu had a good view on the stairs just now. He saw the driver who brought them here today behind Zeref. The two seemed to be discussing something in a low voice. Zeref also handed the driver a bunch of colorful things and gave the driver a few words.
If Bai Liu read it correctly, what Zeref gave the driver should be the currency of this world. Although he was not sure, Bai Liu's intuition about money judgment was 100% trustworthy.
[You have inspired the plot characters to hide the subplot - Zeref's bloody conspiracy]
[Please explore the entire branch plot, and the point reward is 50. The current branch plot completion rate is 15%]
Bai Liu narrowed his eyes slightly, put his hand into his collar, took out the one-dollar coin with a hole punched in it, and pointed it at the driver. Character information popped up on the panel.
[npc: driver]
[Character introduction: Your driver, the driver who took you and your group to Siren Town. This driver was hired for you by Zeref who is said to know Siren Town very well. He has a criminal history such as arson, robbery, etc.]
Sure enough, this is also an NPC with status.
Bai Liu had never had direct contact with the driver before. The driver had been sitting in the front seat while driving. Bai Liu was sitting in the last row and could not see the driver. The driver did not get out of the car when he got off, so Bai Liu never saw the driver's appearance, so he never recognized the driver's personal information.
He didn't feel anything before, but now Bai Liu has come to his senses. It seems that Zeref has been blocking the contact between Bai Liu and the driver intentionally or unintentionally, whether he chooses to sit between Bai Liu and the driver, or screams when he is about to get off the car, preventing direct contact between Bai Liu and the driver...
What little conspiracy did these two people need to hide from Bai Liu.
But the plot, based on the information currently known to Bai Liu, can be guessed: Zeref paid the driver, who had a certain criminal history, and asked him to do things for him. This matter has been tentatively decided. Bai Liu thinks it should be revenge on Andre.
When entering the town, the driver had already said that many people in this town had no source of income for a long time, and asked them to be careful. Bai Liu thought this was a reminder before, but now it seems that it is a proud and arrogant warning from the driver, and a kind of zoning of prey. He is warning Zeref to show his ability. Without his cooperation and protection, Zeref will be easily hurt by other citizens in this town.
Of course, he is also a citizen of Siren Town, and he is also short of money. Of course, he may also rob Zeref and his car because of lack of money.
This driver seems to have done a lot of illegal things with money, and he doesn't seem to be very controlled. He is obviously crazy about money. When he entered Siren Town, he threatened them insinuatingly. It's no wonder that Zeref stayed up most of the night and came down to get money to this driver.
If he doesn't get the money in time, there's no telling what the driver will do.
Bai Liu returned to his room before Zeref saw him, and helped Zeref close the quilt and put down something dark. Bai Liu looked at the thing Zeref put down through the peephole, and it looked a bit like - a large piece of fish?
Soon Bai Liu saw a bunch of gloomy white mermaid sculptures gathered in front of Andre's room.
The dull creaking sound of the sculpture moving echoed in the corridor again.
For safety reasons, Bai Liu covered the peephole of his room with a white cloth to prevent the mermaid from prying, and blocked the door with a cabinet., hoping that if the mermaid breaks in, he can make some noise to wake him up.
His physical strength was also about to be cleared. After Bai Liu finished all this, he lay on the bed. Go up, close your eyes, and have a dreamless night.
————
When Bai Liu woke up the next day, the closet door and the room door were closed, but the bathroom door was about to open.
The white willow cloths are overlapping each other in various twisted and weird postures, moving towards the bathroom door. The hands of some mermaid statues have already reached the bathroom door handle, and are only one step away from turning away.
The postures of these mermaid statues reminded Bai Liu of when he was playing with 123 wooden figures. He suddenly turned around and saw the people behind him unable to control their expressions and postures. At that time, he thought it was a bit funny and amusing, but now seeing these eerie and cold white sculptures chasing after the surging people behind the door to come out, Bai Liu didn't smile at all.
When these human-like marble sculptures are stacked like this, the pressure on people is even stronger, because their eyes are staring at Bai Liu in a small space with high density, which makes Bai Liu feel very uncomfortable, or in other words, normal people will feel uncomfortable when being looked at by so many pairs of dead eyes.
Bai Liu closed the bathroom door. He no longer cared about these sculptures and did not tie them up.
Because there is no point anymore.
These things break free faster and faster. If you can't find more weaknesses to control this thing, constantly binding it with cloth is a very cost-effective method. It may also train these sculptures' ability to quickly untie them.
[Player Bai Liu completed the main mission - staying overnight in the house without being alienated, and was rewarded with 20 points]
[Current balance: 23 points, props can be purchased. Do players want to buy them? 】
Bai Liu Bai Liu bought a powerful searchlight flashlight with 15 points and 8 points left - he thought for a moment.
….I wonder if there is such a 3D holographic projection device.
[Yes, one with 4 points. We are holding a promotion and discount event. Three with 8 points. Would you like to buy 3 of them? 】
Bai Liu nodded without thinking: [Yes! 】
As a social creature who is short of money, two of the words he hates to hear the most in his life are definitely "discount" and "promotion".
After he bought it, he happily started playing with the 3D projector he bought. Moreover, the quality of the projector he got at a discount was not bad. After Bai Liu recorded his character image and projected it out, he was surprised and praised. There was no sense of inferiority at all. The colors were lifelike and the characters were vivid. Looking at it in light and shadow, it almost looked like a real person.
Bai Liu was very satisfied with the product he purchased.
But the audience who watched him were very dissatisfied, gesticulating around the small TV and sighing repeatedly.
"Does this newcomer want to use the projector as a mermaid sculpture with human eyes? The weakness in the monster book says that it must be looked at directly with human eyes. This projector can only fool the mermaid sculpture for a while, and it won't last long."
"I actually sold a projector at a discount. This thing looks high-end, but it's useless! Otherwise, it wouldn't be a slow-selling item that no one would buy for one point! What is this newcomer thinking!"
“…Yes, this projector was on sale when I came in, and now after so many years, it’s still on sale…”
"Fuck, 23 points, which are obviously the highest points currently in the novice area, were all wasted. I didn't buy a single useful thing! Are you out of your mind?"
Suddenly a player shouted in surprise in front of a small screen: "Come here quickly!! There is a newbie here who bought a flaming torch! This thing can defeat the mermaid, he is stable!"
The crowd left Bai Liu's small TV screen with a roar, and gathered around the newbie who was said to have bought the right props, nodding in agreement.
"Yes, this is a regular level-breaking prop. This newbie has a good idea."
"StrongThe firework torch can be used three times. If you control it well, he should be the only one among this batch of newcomers to pass the level. "
There were only a few people left in front of Bai Liu's small TV.
[34 people were watching Bai Liu’s small TV, and 167 people left]
[50 people canceled their likes on Bailiu TV, and 44 people canceled their likes on Bailiu TV.
After Bai Liu played with his props, he walked out of the room and went to Zeref's room first to wake him up.
Zeref obviously had a bad sleep last night, his complexion was pale, and there were dark circles under his eyes from tiredness under his round glasses.
As for the number of mermaid sculptures in Zeref's room, Bai Liu visually inspected them and found that they were similar to those in his own room. However, unlike the sculptures in Zeref's room that he had locked up, these sculptures were placed quietly in place. He didn't know if it was Bai Liu's illusion. He felt that the sculptures in Zeref's room looked obviously more realistic than those in his room, and their faces also became slightly similar to Zeref's...
The white marble case of the mermaid sculpture has a layer of opaque ruddy color, and its eyes seem to be moving in their sockets at any time. The expression is also comfortable and natural, like a fish that has absorbed enough water. The scales on the fish's tail have stretched out, and there is a faint fishy smell in the room.
Bai Liu went to Lucy and Andre's room to observe again. He made a careful comparison and found that the mermaid sculptures in these rooms were indeed closer to human skin color than the ones in his room, both in terms of touch and color, and their facial features began to resemble those of the people living in the room.
